section_summary.extract_value: This Procedure describes a single, unnamed study (Study X) that recruited female introductory psychology students via a departmental research board in exchange for class credit. Participants completed measures in a classroom research lab (paper-and-pencil), and measures were counterbalanced to control for order effects.
